mapper.update: update member_funding_wallet wallet set wallet.balance = wallet.balance + #{amount} where wallet.id = #{walletId}
update member_funding_wallet wallet set wallet.balance = wallet.balance - #{amount} where wallet.id = #{walletId} and wallet.balance >= #{amount}
